about.label: About Us
about.title: Crafting Culinary Memories Since 1991
about.p1: For over two decades, we've been passionate about sharing the authentic taste of India. Our chefs bring generations of culinary wisdom, using traditional recipes passed down through families, combined with the finest locally-sourced ingredients.
about.p2: From intimate family gatherings to grand wedding celebrations, we pour our heart into every dish we create. Our commitment to quality, authenticity, and exceptional service has made us the preferred choice for Indian catering across the region.
